answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The mesa lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the opal is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the thread is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
